description: Prices a device built from catalog modules: parts, enclosure, assembly, shipping, Protoship fee and VAT for the destination country, as one total, plus a delivery estimate, a quote_id for reserve, a reserve_url your user can open, and an ESPHome starter config. If the device breaks a rule (power, plugs, unknown part), it returns the problems to fix. Free, no side effects.

country.description: Two-letter EU country code of the delivery address, e.g. DE. Default DE.

parts.description: Module ids from catalog, e.g. ["bme280", "oled"]. Repeat an id or use "micro_servo:2" for two. The Nano ESP32 and the carrier are always included.

name: quote
title: Price a device
